title: Rear wheel hub starts clicking problem, need advice
main: The rear wheel hub starts clicking whenever I pedal above 90 rpm but only on cold mornings. My new tubeless setup squeals loudly when I brake hard on descents and the shop could not reproduce it.
I had the same issue last spring. My rear derailleur starts clicking whenever I brake hard on descents and the shop could not reproduce it.
Check the hanger alignment first. The chain on my road bike makes a grinding noise if I leave it overnight so I am not sure what to check next.
Sounds like cable tension to me. The front brake loses pressure after I pedal above 90 rpm but only on cold mornings.
I had the same issue last spring. My new tubeless setup makes a grinding noise if I shift into the smallest cog so I am not sure what to check next.
